Class CameraAimAssistBlocks

java.lang.Object
net.raphimc.viabedrock.api.model.CameraAimAssistBlocks
public final class CameraAimAssistBlocks extends Object
Native block discovery, two-slice cache and visible-face queries. World geometry and policies are caller-owned.

  • Method Details

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Clear retains allocation between slices; removal of the native component resets its bucket count too.

    • capture

      public void capture(int tick, CameraAimAssistFrustum frustum, boolean liquids, CameraAimAssistBlocks.World world)
      The caller refreshes its cached frustum on odd ticks only. Odd captures clear the previous targets; even captures append the lower half. Both halves retain the first observation of each block position.

    • visibleTargets

      public List<CameraAimAssistBlocks.Target> visibleTargets(CameraPose.Vector eye, float distance, boolean liquids, CameraAimAssistBlocks.World world)

    • visiblePoints

      public static List<CameraAimAssistBlocks.Point> visiblePoints(CameraAimAssistBlocks.Hit hit, CameraPose.Vector eye, float distance, boolean liquids, CameraAimAssistBlocks.World world)
      Face points remain in Bedrock down/up/north/south/west/east order. Excluded obstructions still block visibility.

    • cast

      public static CameraAimAssistBlocks.Hit cast(CameraPose.Vector start, CameraPose.Vector end, int maximumSteps, boolean exactBounds, boolean liquids, CameraAimAssistBlocks.World world)
      Maximum steps counts DDA transitions, not Euclidean distance. The starting cell always uses the base layer and skips a box enclosing the start. Later cells prefer accepted extra blocks when liquids are enabled. Discovery intersects whole grid cells; obstruction intersects their native selection boxes.

    • intersect

      public static CameraAimAssistBlocks.Surface intersect(CameraRaycast.Box box, CameraPose.Vector start, CameraPose.Vector end)
      Native aim intersections use world-space float math. CameraRaycast.Box instead subtracts the block cell before intersecting camera collision shapes; reusing that method changes large-coordinate results.
